claims.claim: Devin correctly resolves 13.86%* of the issues end-to-end, far exceeding the previous state-of-the-art of 1.96%.
Even when given the exact files to edit, the best previous models can only resolve 4.80% of issues.
Devin was evaluated on a random 25% subset of the dataset.
Devin can train and fine tune its own AI models. Devin sets up fine tuning for a large language model given only a link to a research repository on GitHub.
Devin is currently in early access as we ramp up capacity.
We are well funded, including a $21 million Series A led by Founders Fund.
